prose: Bloomberg reports Amazon spent more than $77 billion on property and equipment in Q3, producing a free cash outflow of $42.4 billion, with e-commerce revenue slowing. The company said in July it would likely spend $220 billion on capex in 2026.
highlights: Amazon Q3 property and equipment spend: $77B+
Free cash outflow of $42.4B in the quarter
E-commerce revenue slowed alongside the spending
